fusions.name: Crushing Coil
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Your coils crush the target for 9 blunt damage and leave it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped From the Rafters
fusions.desc: You drop your full weight onto the ground: every enemy within 3 tiles takes 30 blunt damage and becomes [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Weighted Coils
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Squeeze
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, you deal 12% more damage.
